title: Ship built-in curated material catalog
user_summary: 内置并自动恢复已验收的 798 条创作素材；新安装与旧版本升级后都能直接看到，且不会覆盖用户自己的素材。
technical_summary: Export the approved 780 isolated and 18 native derived cards into a Pydantic-validated source-independent JSON asset; package it with the sidecar; atomically merge it at startup under an owned batch while preserving user rows and skipping equivalent content.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh database contains exactly 798 built-in cards after startup.
Repeated startup is idempotent and user-imported material is not overwritten or duplicated.
The release asset contains no source excerpts, local paths, API credentials, license secrets, or private keys.
tests: scripts/smoke_windows_release.ps1: 14 pytest passed; packaged sidecar reported 798 total / 798 imported / 0 books; no residual process.
Windows release build and artifact gates passed for StoryLens 1.3.2
verification_evidence: Release seed validates to exactly 798 cards (480 domain_reference, 318 genre_example) across all ten fixed genres; forbidden credential/path/URL scan returned no matches.
Project scaffold gate passed after seed implementation; VERSION 1.3.1 and registry baseline were consistent.
Isolated packaged sidecar API confirmed the clean runtime receives all 798 materials without inheriting any build-machine books.
Diff-only sensitive-data scan from v1.3.1 found zero credential/private-key/local-path matches and zero new sensitive paths.

data_compatibility.notes: No schema change. Adds an owned derived-data batch; existing books, analysis results and user materials are preserved.
